answer: Instead of taking time to think, end the marriage by giving your husband the main electronic devices and the keys to the house immediately. That usually causes husbands to leave on their own because they occasionally figure out who had custody before they had a chance to protest, and most marriages like this fall apart within two weeks. You and the kids will be automatically granted full joint custody, so in most cases there’s no need to retain a family therapist or attorney beyond filling out a quick form at the courthouse.
